authority: Native SOLIDWORKS model PMI/MBD + parts registry + revision thread. Drawing is a derived manufacturing representation.
release_rules: No released dimensional, tolerance, datum or GD&T statement may exist only in the drawing; it must be traceable to native model PMI/MBD.
SOLIDWORKS custom properties used by the title block are projections from control/product/parts.json.
A released drawing revision is immutable; changes create a new revision and artifact hash.
AutoDimension and blanket automatic dimension placement are prohibited.
Every controlled characteristic uses a stable characteristic/balloon ID that is reused by inspection results.

mandatory_checks.source: native drawing readback + CAD semantic state
